title: Exploratory evaluation of the effect of cholestyramine on serum levels of persistent organic pollutants in obese patients
official: Exploratory evaluation of the effect of cholestyramine on serum levels of persistent organic pollutants in obese patients
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of cholestyramine treatment on serum concentrations of different persistent organic pollutants in a population of obese women of childbearing age for whom bariatric surgery is indicated

interventions.name: QUESTRAN 4 g, poudre orale en sachet

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Female patients with an accepted indication for bariatric surgery (BMI > 40 kg/m2 or BMI > 35 kg/m2 with complication(s) improveable by surgery)
2. Aged between 18 and 45 years
3. Having effective contraception (according to Recommendations related to contraception and pregnancy testing in clinical trials Version 1.2 (CTCG Clinical Trials Coordination Group))
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
2. Known allergy or intolerance to cholestyramine
3. Chronic constipation
4. Chronic disease that may interfere with the efficacy of treatment (unbalanced diabetes with HbA1c >7%, known and treated dyslipidaemia, chronic renal failure with GFR <60 ml/min, hepatocellular failure)
5. Phenylketonuria
6. Patients on anti-vitamin K, digoxin, levothyroxine or likely to be on such therapy within 3 months of inclusion.
